description: This Kotlin source file defines the SyncWorker class, which is responsible for periodically syncing local documents to a cloud backend. It uses Android's WorkManager framework with a CoroutineWorker to handle asynchronous background tasks.

classes.name: SyncWorker
classes.description: A background worker class that handles synchronizing local documents to a cloud service, extending CoroutineWorker for asynchronous execution.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Overrides the suspend function to perform the sync operation. Retrieves an access token, fetches all documents from the repository, and currently simulates a successful sync.
